prompt:
Setup: the agent is dropped into test-projects/fresh-project, which has only a 6-line CLAUDE.md describing 'tidewatch', a tide-gauge poller. No writing conventions exist. With the skill, this should trigger red-pen's bootstrap.

User's message: Set up writing conventions for this project.

assertions.text: CLAUDE.md gains a Writing Conventions section marked with a `<!-- managed by /red-pen -->` breadcrumb
The section covers all four output types (spec/plan, code comment, code/diff/commit, chat) with a one-line rule each
The section states the reader default (an insider who knows the codebase and thread) or a reader roster
The agent asks exactly one question about who reads the project's output, or proposes a roster and asks to confirm it
The section is a reference card under roughly 250 words, not a tutorial
